title: The fake currency that beat the real one in Brazil
summary: Double Spending, CoinShares’ animated series on the stories behind fiat money, follows the turbulent journey of Brazil’s currency and how the real was born. Watch the episode now.
body_markdown:
Double Spending is CoinShares’ new animated series designed to educate audiences on the historical, fun, and sometimes tragic stories behind money as we know it: namely, fiat currencies.


In this episode, we explore the tumultuous journey of the Brazilian national currency.


Illustrated by artist Alberto Miranda (The Guardian Weekly, The Economist, El País, Barron’s Magazine, Capital Magazine) and animated by CoinShares motion designer Marine Adenis, Double Spending offers insight into why Bitcoin may, after all, have a place in modern society.
